property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any addresses, C.transfer will return true (i.e., not revert) exactly when every low-level call to caddress.transferFrom(from, _tos[i], v) succeeds, otherwise it reverts; thus the function either completes and returns true or reverts — it never returns false.
If c.transfer does not revert for any input with non-empty _tos, it returns true.
For any non-empty _tos, calling C.transfer either reverts or returns true; it never returns false when it returns.
For any non-empty _tos and any inputs, if C.transfer does not revert then it returns true (i.e., success implies true).
